<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TAX MATTERS AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This TAX MATTERS AGREEMENT, dated as of October&nbsp;1, 2026 (this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;), by and between CORTEVA, INC., a Delaware
corporation (&#8220;<U>RemainCo</U>&#8221;), and VYLOR INC., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;<U>SpinCo</U>&#8221;). Each of RemainCo and SpinCo is sometimes referred to herein as a &#8220;<U>Party</U>&#8221;, and collectively as the
&#8220;<U>Parties</U>&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>W I T N E S S E T H: </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS,</B> RemainCo is the common parent of an affiliated group of corporations, within the meaning of Section&nbsp;1504(a) of the Code,
that has elected to file consolidated U.S. federal income Tax Returns, and SpinCo is a member of that group; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS,</B> pursuant to,
and subject to the terms of, the Separation Agreement, the Parties have effected, or agreed to effect, the Transactions; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS,</B>
the Parties intend that certain of the Transactions qualify for the Intended Tax Treatment; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS,</B> SpinCo will cease to be a
member of the Consolidated Group of which RemainCo is the common parent after the Distribution. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>NOW, THEREFORE,</B> in consideration
of the foregoing and the mutual agreements, provisions and covenants contained in this Agreement, the Parties hereby agree as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE I </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><U>DEFINITIONS </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U> 1.1. <U>Definition of Terms.</U> As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the following meanings. Capitalized
terms used but not defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(1) &#8220;<U>25%
Acquisition Transaction</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.4(b)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(2)
&#8220;<U>Action</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(3) &#8220;<U>Active Trade or
Business</U>&#8221; shall mean the active conduct (determined in accordance with Section&nbsp;355(b) of the Code and the Regulations thereunder) of any trade or business described in <U>Schedule</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;A</U> for purposes of satisfying
the requirements of Section&nbsp;355(b) of the Code. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(4) &#8220;<U>Affiliate</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the
Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(5) &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(6) &#8220;<U>Ancillary Agreement</U>&#8221; shall mean an Ancillary Agreement, as defined in the Separation Agreement, other than this
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(7) &#8220;<U>Applicable </U><U>RemainCo</U><U> Percentage</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(8) &#8220;<U>Applicable SpinCo Percentage</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(9) &#8220;<U>Business Day</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation Agreement. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>(10)</U> &#8220;<U>Chemours TMA</U>&#8221; shall mean that certain Tax Matters Agreement,
dated as of June&nbsp;26, 2015, by and among E.I. du Pont de Nemours and Company and The Chemours Company, as modified, amended and/or supplemented at or prior to the Effective Time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(11) &#8220;<U>Claiming Group</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.9</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(12) &#8220;<U>Code</U>&#8221; shall mean the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(13) &#8220;<U>Consolidated Group</U>&#8221; shall mean a group of Persons reporting and paying Taxes on a consolidated, combined or unitary
Tax basis that includes at least one member of the RemainCo Group and at least one member of the SpinCo Group. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(14)
&#8220;<U>Conveyancing and Allocation Instrument</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(15)
&#8220;<U>Determination</U>&#8221; shall mean the final resolution of liability for any Tax for any taxable period by or as a result of (a)&nbsp;a final and unappealable decision, judgment, decree or other order by any court of competent
jurisdiction; (b)&nbsp;a final settlement, compromise or other agreement with the relevant Taxing Authority, an agreement that constitutes a determination under Section&nbsp;1313(a)(4) of the Code, an agreement contained in an IRS <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Form&nbsp;870-AD,</FONT> a closing agreement or accepted offer in compromise under Section&nbsp;7121 or 7122 of the Code or a comparable agreement under state, local or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> Law;
(c)&nbsp;the expiration of the applicable statute of limitations; or (d)&nbsp;the payment of the Tax by a Party (or its Affiliate) that is responsible for payment of that Tax under applicable Law, including with respect to any item disallowed or
adjusted by a Taxing Authority; <U>provided</U> that, in the case of the foregoing <U>clause (d)</U>, both Parties agree that no action should be taken to recoup that payment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(16) &#8220;<U>Dispute</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3(a)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(17) &#8220;<U>Dispute Resolution Firm</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3(b)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(18) &#8220;<U>Distribution</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation Agreement. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(20) &#8220;<U>Domestic Use Agreement</U>&#8221; shall mean a domestic use agreement as described in

Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(23) &#8220;<U>EIDP Distribution</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the Separation Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(24) &#8220;<U>Entitled Group</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.9</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(25) &#8220;<U>Escalation Notice</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;6.3(a)</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(26) &#8220;<U>Financing Transactions</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Schedule M</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(27) &#8220;<U>Gain Recognition Agreement</U>&#8221; shall mean a gain recognition agreement as described in

 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(30) &#8220;<U>Indemnifying Party</U>&#8221; shall mean a Party that has any obligation to

</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(38) &#8220;<U>IRS</U>&#8221; shall mean the United States Internal Revenue Service. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(40) &#8220;<U>Net Payable Amount</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;7.1</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(41) &#8220;<U>Ordinary Course of Business</U>&#8221; shall mean, with respect to an action taken (or to be taken) by a Person, that the
action is taken in the ordinary course of the normal <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">day-to-day</FONT></FONT> operations of that Person. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(42) &#8220;<U>Ordinary Taxes</U>&#8221; shall mean Taxes other than (i)&nbsp;Transfer Taxes and (ii)&nbsp;Transaction Taxes. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(43) &#8220;<U>Party</U>&#8221; or &#8220;<U>Parties</U>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto. </P>

</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(45) &#8220;<U>Paying Party</U>&#8221; shall mean any Party from which payment is being sought pursuant to the provisions of this

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(47) &#8220;<U>Post-Distribution Period</U>&#8221; shall mean a taxable period (or portion thereof) beginning after the Distribution Date.

STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> legal, accounting and other advisory or court fees incurred in connection with liability for Taxes described in <U>clause</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;(</U><U>i</U><U>)</U> or <U>(ii)</U>. </P>
